check_causal_lm_perplexity: check the perplexity of generated tokens from a causal language model against a threshold
check_multimodal_perplexity: check the perplexity of generated tokens from a multimodal model using a conversation input
compare_eager_exported_outputs: recursively compare eager mode outputs with exported model outputs using tolerance thresholds
test_causal_lm_quality: test a causal LM output quality by loading a pretrained model and computing perplexity
test_multimodal_quality: test a multimodal model output quality by processing conversation inputs and computing perplexity
